result.description:
Wall and Floor Tiler
APD Flooring Pty Ltd
$79,000-$86,000
 
About Us
APD Flooring Pty Ltd is a trusted name in the flooring and tiling industry, known for delivering quality workmanship on residential and commercial projects. As our client base continues to grow, we're looking for a skilled and reliable Wall and Floor Tiler to join our team.
The Role
We're seeking an experienced Wall and Floor Tiler to carry out tiling work across a variety of residential and commercial projects. You'll be responsible for preparing surfaces, laying tiles to a high standard, and ensuring every job meets our quality and safety expectations.
Key Responsibilities
• Measure, cut, and lay wall and floor tiles (ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, and mosaic)
• Prepare and level surfaces prior to tiling, including waterproofing where required
• Read and interpret plans and job specifications accurately
• Apply adhesives, grout, and sealants correctly and efficiently
• Ensure all work complies with relevant Australian Standards and workplace safety requirements
• Maintain a clean and organised worksite
• Liaise professionally with clients, site supervisors, and other trades
What We're Looking For
• Minimum 3 years' hands-on experience as a Wall and Floor Tiler or relevant trade qualification (Certificate or Certificate IV in Wall and Floor Tiling) plus 1 or 2 years working experience
• Strong attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality finishes
• Sound knowledge of waterproofing practices and Australian building codes
• Sound knowledge of the Raimondi Levelling System (RLS) to lay tiles
• Current driver's licence and reliable transport
• White Card (construction induction card)
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Good communication skills and a professional, reliable attitude

Handle escalated customer queries and complaints in a professional and solution-focused manner.  Skills and experience  To be considered, you will have:  A Diploma in business, retail management or a related discipline, OR at least 3 years’ experience in retail management with staff supervision responsibilities.  Proven experience managing a busy retail outlet for at least 1 year full time (e.g. lotto, tobacconist, convenience, or similar).  Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, motivate and retain a small team of sales assistants.  Excellent communication and customer service skills, with a hands-on approach on the shop floor. Ability to work a rotating roster including weekends, public holidays and peak trading periods. Your new company   A growing Managed Service Provider in Melbourne's South-East requires an IT Onsite Technician for a permanent opportunity commencing immediately, in a role that is based primarily onsite for a given portfolio of clients. The company promotes a collaborative and supportive work environment, offering exposure to leading technologies and excellent career progression pathways.   Your new role    In this exciting new role, you will be: 
 
 Attending on-site client visits to perform audits and set up desktops, laptops, printers, access points, etc. 
 Installing applications remotely and onsite. 
 Completing SSL renewals, networking and server builds. 
 Assisting with the delivery of infrastructure projects. 
 Developing and maintaining in-depth knowledge of clients' environments. 
 Liaising with 3rd party vendors on both hardware and software. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed    To be successful in your application, you will need: 
 
 Demonstrated experience of providing level 1 & 2 IT support onsite. 
 Proven experience with Windows / Mac OS, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, VMware / Hyper-V and Network troubleshooting. 
 Experience with IT Glue and ConnectWise is highly advantageous. 
 Highly developed troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 A tertiary education in Information Technology as well as Azure, Microsoft, ITIL and Prince2 certifications are beneficial. 
 Experience working within a Managed Service Provider. 
 A current driver's license and vehicle. 
 
   What you'll get in return    Working in an organisation where they develop and grow careers, you will be offered a competitive salary package and access to a company car. This organisation prides itself on internal promotion and career development. Do not miss out!
